name: Celestial Tea Crisp
desc: A novel take on Wangxiao Cakes. Made using Fontaine's laminated dough technique, where the dough is folded over and over to create its delicate layers, this flaky molded pastry is filled with a rich tea reduction made from roasted and finely ground Chenyu Adeptea and finished with a golden egg wash. This is a perfect blend of Fontainian form and the soul of Liyue.

value.text: Increases all party members' ATK by 272 and CRIT Rate by 8% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
